segmentation.text: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal:
When proper signs have been erected,
at a clearly marked stop line
or, if there is none, before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection
or, if there is none, then at the point nearest the intersection
where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the through highway.
After having stopped or, in the event of a yield sign, slowed or stopped,
the driver shall yield the right-of-way
to other vehicles which have entered the intersection from such through highway
or which are approaching so closely on such through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

elements.justification: As in NRS_484B_257_1_o1: x as a member of the admitted traffic aggregate; a dev.human_direction ('a person directing traffic') with role police_officer, or a dev.traffic_signal not dev.inoperative ('showing no valid indication'), governing x's approach carrier or the intersection (dev.governs 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection').
As in NRS_484B_257_1_o1: a dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governing x's approach carrier or the intersection, at x's entry (drv.motion.entering_region).
'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate; 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.

'shall yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210 'to proceed ... in preference to another vehicle'): x does not enter the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region over rel.occupies) while a through-highway vehicle is owed precedence.

'other vehicles' are the admitted aggregate. 'which have entered the intersection from such through highway': y occupies the intersection (rel.occupies) and has occupied it at every observation since its latest entry into it (drv.motion.entering_region 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before', read through a past operator), at which entry y occupied a carrier (st.travel_region) whose entrance end is the intersection (st.lane_enters) and that lies on the through highway (st.on_way 'the public way ... a structure region lies on', of kind st.highway) on which x's approach carrier does not lie.

operationalizations.standard: approaching so closely on the through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time the driver is moving across or within the intersection
operationalizations.convention: Gap acceptance (HCM critical headway for a minor-street crossing or turn): a vehicle on an approach carrier of the intersection lying on the through highway (rel.occupies, st.lane_enters, st.on_way), outside the intersection, is an immediate hazard where its ground distance to the intersection (st.region_geometry) is at most its speed (kin.speed) times p.immediate_hazard_gap; the critical gap stands for the time the subject needs to move across or within the intersection, and the bound moves with the other vehicle's proximity and speed.

applicability: As NRS_484B_257_1_o1: x is a vehicle entering intersection i at this observation (drv.motion.entering_region x i) through an approach carrier c it occupies (rel.occupies x c, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c i); a dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governs c or i; x, a member of traffic (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic), is not controlled by a dev.human_direction with role police_officer or a dev.traffic_signal that is not dev.inoperative governing c or i. And NRS_484B_257_1_o1 is complied with for x at this observation (rule NRS_484B_257_1_o1 {x -> x}): that rule being engaged at exactly this entry, its compliance is the fact the words refer to, that x stopped, or under a yield sign slowed or stopped, on this approach.
obligation: At this entry, for every highway h2 (st.highway) on which i lies and c does not (st.on_way i h2; st.on_way c h2 false), no vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) either (1) occupies i (rel.occupies y i) and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) that lies on h2 (st.on_way c2 h2); or (2) occupies an approach carrier c2 of i lying on h2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.lane_enters c2 i, st.on_way c2 h2), does not occupy i, and st_region_geometry_distance y i is at most kin_speed y times p.immediate_hazard_gap. Where y's entry into i is not observed, whether (1) holds for y is unknown.

narrowings.why: Control of traffic is read as control of x's own approach or intersection; officer and signal presence are read as their status.
'proper signs' are read through the presence of a stop or yield sign.
'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
The yield is judged at x's entry into the intersection.

'during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection' is read through the critical gap, not through a prediction of x's own crossing time; 'such through highway' is a highway the intersection lies on and x's signed approach does not.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: dev.stop_sign governs c; x halts at the stop line marking c, then enters i while vehicle y on approach carrier c2 of the crossing highway h2 is 25 m from i at 15 m/s.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x enters i as the only road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No sign governs c or i; x enters i.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but kin.speed is not observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: x halts at its stop line and enters i while vehicle y, whose entry into i through c2 on h2 is recorded, occupies i.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x never halted or slowed on the approach (NRS_484B_257_1_o1 not complied with): this duty does not arise.
